fact: The Ministry of Health's statistical report for 2021 states that DHIS2, an electronic system whose design was completed in 2018 and on which staff in all municipalities were widely trained, had become an important source of routine data from health facilities, and it tabulates 2021 outpatient attendance at primary health care facilities and at hospitals and medical centres, by region, as entered in DHIS2.
title: التقرير الإحصائي السنوي لوزارة الصحة للعام 2021م
